tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Creates a 30-day bucket and its secret bearer token.

tools.name: get_bucket_permissions
tools.description: Return currently permitted buckets and operations.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

tools.name: get_bucket
tools.description: Return bucket details with storage and egress usage.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

tools.name: upload_object
tools.description: Return a secret, short-lived PUT URL for an object up to 5 GB.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

tools.name: download_object
tools.description: Return a secret, short-lived GET URL for an object's bytes.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List one page of objects and path-like prefixes, ordered by key.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

prefix.description: Only return keys beginning with this prefix.

recursive.description: True for a flat listing; false for immediate children.

page_size.description: Maximum objects to return, from 1 to 1000.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token from the preceding page.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object; versioned buckets may retain older versions.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.

tools.name: get_object_metadata
tools.description: Return an object's size, timestamps, ETag, content type, metadata, and tags.

object_key.description: Complete object key, including path-like prefixes.

bucket_token.description: Secret bearer token returned with the public bucket.
